messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The notifier's flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-18]
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- As of 2025-04-07, the Ember team reported that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. [decision; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- As of 2025-12-29, the auth gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-29]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team has a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by Cinder as of 2025-06-11, having moved from the Boreal team. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- Following the INC-2025-017 review, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- As of 2025-11-11, the billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 for the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-18]
- As of 2026-03-11, the ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- As of 2025-08-25, the ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-08-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-25]
- As of 2026-05-19, the job scheduler's leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2025-03-26 the Dune team observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-03-26 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-26]
- On 2026-04-14 the Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- The product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC window no longer applies. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
    earlier: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]
